goals.title: Rename Session Picker to Dojo Picker
goals.description: Align picker vocabulary with the topology model: Dojos are resumable terminal layouts, while Lairs are workspace containers and Splints are panes/processes. Rename user-facing Session Picker and Recent Sessions surfaces to Dojo Picker and Recent Dojos; add canonical `splinterm dojos`; retain documented compatibility aliases; and update internal picker names where safe.

goals.title: Redesign Lair retention and saved-workspace lifecycle
goals.description: Make inactive Lairs useful and intentional rather than accumulated anonymous history. Define named, pinned, preset-derived, and disposable Lair states; automatically retire low-value exited `terminal-*` Lairs under a clear bounded policy; preserve active detached Lairs; expose save, pin, restore, and delete actions; clarify inactive Dojo restoration; and make picker presentation distinguish live, detached, restorable, and expired states without persisting shell contents or sensitive terminal data.

goals.title: Reconcile alpha2 release state and planning authority
goals.description: Safely reconcile local main with origin/main while preserving the existing dirty website and Wayland changes; verify alpha2/AUR release provenance; deduplicate the already-upstream modal-routing hotfix; and update TODO, roadmap, status, PRD, packaging, and plan statuses so release truth has one authority.

goals.title: Correct selection theme palette composition
goals.description: Preserve theme-provided selection RGB roles verbatim while varying only explicit presentation alpha. Replace framebuffer-baked selection blending with a separate theme-color-plus-alpha layer, keep selected glyph foreground untinted, and add renderer coverage including Sakura Mochi #f23888.

goals.title: Integrate Splinterm with Omarchy screensaver
goals.description: Implement Plan 0032: validate and propagate XDG-only app-ID overrides, advertise X-TerminalArgAppId, package a Splinterm-owned screensaver profile, prepare the bounded upstream Omarchy launcher change, and record approved graphical acceptance without overwriting Omarchy- or user-owned files.

goals.title: Add file and image path insertion
goals.description: Support Wayland file drops by inserting shell-escaped local paths into the focused Splint, and support clipboard image data via collision-safe saved files without changing normal text paste. Define MIME, destination, cleanup, confirmation, bracketed-paste, failure, privacy, and edge-case contracts with focused tests.

goals.title: Close the public website implementation milestone
goals.description: Finish and validate the existing site work, verify deployment configuration and release claims, and close Plan 0026 only after separately approved preview/production deployment and rollback evidence.
